result.answer: As far as Shutter can check, yes, the message is fine. It is a well-formed transfer (ADT^A02, version 2.5.1). It reads correctly against its schema, and its version matches the route's. It names patient MRN-T1 (HOSP), encounter ENC-T1, and a move to WARD-B, bed BAY2-04, at 08:20 UTC on 15 Oct 2026. The demo bed-management system did not turn it down for its content. It answered 'unavailable' (HTTP 503). Under its contract, that means it never checked or wrote anything. So the failure was about the receiver being unavailable, not the message. One limit: that schema check covers structure only. The receiver itself never judged this message. A transfer is also allowed while the patient is admitted. But being acceptable is not the same as being safe to resend. The receiver has already applied a later transfer to WARD-C (08:45 UTC). Resending this one would put the patient back on WARD-B, a ward they have already left. On that point I agree with the plan to send nothing. The one alternative on file (W1) is a setting for sites that keep a full movement history. Under it, this case would have gone to a person instead of being closed.
